name: Groww Fees Explainer MCP Server
description: MCP server providing Notes, Email, and Audit tools for the Fees Explainer Agent

tools.name: append_to_notes
tools.description: Appends a fee explanation entry to the notes/documentation file

entry_title.description: Title of the notes entry (e.g., 'Fee Explanation: Exit Load & ELSS')

clarifiers.description: Questions and answers from the clarification phase

fee_details.description: Array of fee details with text and source URLs

last_checked.description: Date when the fee information was last verified

tools.approval_prompt: Do you want to append this fee explanation to your notes?

tools.name: create_email_draft
tools.description: Creates a draft email to support/advisor with fee clarification details. Does NOT auto-send.

body.description: Email body content with fee details and sources

tools.approval_prompt: Do you want to create this email draft? (It will NOT be sent automatically)

tools.name: log_audit_entry
tools.description: Logs an audit trail entry for compliance and tracking
tools.approval_prompt: Do you want to log this audit entry?

resources.name: Fee Explanations Notes
resources.description: Markdown file containing all fee explanation entries

resources.name: Audit Log
resources.description: JSONL file containing audit trail entries

approval_mechanism.description: All MCP tool calls require explicit user approval before execution
approval_flow: 2. User is presented with action summary and full payload
3. User approves or rejects each action individually
5. Execution results are returned to agent and user
approval_mechanism.rejection_handling: Rejected actions are skipped and logged. Agent continues with approved actions only.
